id:brain-model: A rear-view brain specimen shows its paired folded cerebral hemispheres, lower cerebellum and attached brainstem. No separate nerve-cell inset is present.
id:spinal-cord-model: A long spinal cord carries representative attached roots at several levels and a bundle of descending lower roots. One lateral root attachment is exposed. Only continuous nervous tissue is shown.
id:school-skull: A skull opened from behind has an empty cranial cavity and a clear basal opening. No face, jaw or future brain outline is added.
id:school-backbone: A vertebral column opened from behind exposes its continuous central canal, descending sacral canal and lateral openings between the supporting bony processes. One selected side opening is clearly exposed.
id:school-protected-brain: The rear-view brain occupies the same opened skull, with its brainstem extending into the basal passage. Ordinary protective membranes and fluid are included.
id:central-nervous-system-model: The rear-view brainstem continues through the skull base into the cord inside the opened posterior vertebral canal. Descending lower roots continue into the sacrum, and one selected lateral nerve exit remains open.
id:sensory-routes: A sensory root has fine rootlets at its inner end, an oval ganglion swelling and a short continuing bundle. Only actual nervous tissue and its connective covering are present.
id:motor-routes: Several fine motor rootlets converge into one short narrow bundle. It has no ganglion and no directional arrows.
id:school-peripheral-nerves: Sensory and motor roots form one continuous Y-shaped junction. The sensory ganglion and converging motor rootlets remain distinct before their fibres enter a shared short trunk with a prepared outer cut end.
id:nervous-system-model: The same rear-view skull and column enclose continuous brainstem, cord and descending roots. One selected nerve shows converging sensory rootlets, an oval ganglion, a separate lower motor root and one common trunk extending through the exposed lateral exit. No separate inset, arrow or duplicate organ is added.
